description: Operational reporting table tracking Checkout Started events, Klaviyo recovery email statuses, simulated purchases, and recovery outcomes. Does not claim unmeasured revenue.

fields.name: Checkout ID
fields.description: Unique checkout identifier generated by Supabase / backend (e.g., chk_...)

fields.name: Customer Email
fields.description: Fictional or test customer email address

fields.name: Cart Value (NGN)
fields.description: Server-validated cart subtotal in Nigerian Naira

fields.name: Products
fields.description: Formatted list of products and quantities in the cart

fields.name: Checkout Date
fields.description: ISO timestamp when Checkout Started was triggered

fields.name: Marketing Consent
fields.description: Whether the customer explicitly opted in to marketing/recovery reminders

fields.name: Recovery URL
fields.description: Secure link that restores the customer's cart in GlowLab
